name: Elena Marsh
title: Medical Director, Ashford Family Clinic
bio: Dr. Marsh has practiced family medicine in Ashford Crossing for 18 years. She sees adults and children and helps patients manage diabetes, high blood pressure and preventive care.

name: Daniel Okonkwo
title: Cardiologist
bio: Dr. Okonkwo focuses on coronary disease, heart failure and preventive cardiology. He sees clinic patients at the Heart and Vascular Center and rounds on the main campus.

name: Priya Natarajan
title: Medical Oncologist
bio: Dr. Natarajan treats breast, lung and gastrointestinal cancers. She works with nurse navigators so every new patient leaves the first visit with a clear next step.

name: James Whitaker
title: Orthopedic Surgeon, Joint Replacement
bio: Dr. Whitaker specializes in hip and knee replacement. Most of his patients go home the day after surgery when it is safe to do so.

name: Sofia Alvarez
title: Obstetrician and Gynecologist
bio: Dr. Alvarez delivers at the Harlow Creek birth center and sees prenatal and gynecology patients in clinic. She offers a midwifery-collaborative model for low-risk pregnancies.

name: Marcus Chen
title: Emergency Physician
bio: Dr. Chen works evenings and nights in the emergency department. He also helps lead the trauma quality committee.

name: Aisha Rahman
title: Pediatrician
bio: Dr. Rahman sees newborns through teens at Ashford Family Clinic. She has a special interest in asthma and adolescent care.

name: Thomas Brennan
title: Internist
bio: Dr. Brennan focuses on adult primary care and complex chronic disease. He is not accepting new patients right now; established patients can still reach him through the portal.

name: Grace Lindqvist
title: Psychiatrist
bio: Dr. Lindqvist provides outpatient psychiatry and consults in the emergency department for crisis assessment. Telehealth follow-ups are available for established patients.

name: Wei Zhang
title: Radiologist
bio: Dr. Zhang reads MRI, CT and ultrasound studies and performs select interventional procedures on the main campus.

name: Rachel Okada
title: General Surgeon
bio: Dr. Okada performs general and laparoscopic surgery, including gallbladder, hernia and soft-tissue cases, in both inpatient and outpatient settings.

name: Samuel Ortiz
title: Physician Assistant, Primary Care
bio: Samuel Ortiz works alongside Dr. Marsh at Ashford Family Clinic. He sees sick visits, wellness exams and follow-ups for chronic conditions.
